markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set [F1], model agreement, and clear margins [F7] support Normal despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Invasive/Benign/InSitu 0% | Decisive Normal, 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (alpha=0.10, 90% coverage) | Single class, 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (12/12) [F6] | Unflagged despite blur (AUROC 0.70) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (83%–86% match) [F5] | Nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.78), pushes toward invasive (+0.41) [F2] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3) · ↓ invasive · Prominent (1.28), pushes against invasive (-0.35) [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Typical (0.80), descriptive only (-0.22) [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Low (0.29), pushes against invasive (-0.19) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion drops P(invasive) over random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section blur masks atypia; reliability ranks errors modestly (AUROC 0.70) despite 100% OOD.
- Sub-threshold margin signals (inferior 73%, superior 57%) or contrast Invasive case BACH_0022 (76% similarity) reflect tumor.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 1**: Inspect non-zero risk regions (7%, 1%) for blurred nuclear atypia.
2. **Regions 3, 0**: Verify benign stroma/fat, ducts (+0.41), and superior margin peak (57%).
3. **Regions 9, 10, 4**: Check inferior margin (73%, 54%), invasion (region 10), and lymphocytes/pleomorphism (region 4).
